overview: SaaS Billing Entitlement Reconciliation addresses source evidence is scattered across documents and transaction systems, leading to repeated checks and incomplete case files in technology and saas operations. The first proof of value uses product events, subscription plans and invoicing. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is incorrect customer invoice rate, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: product events, subscription plans and invoicing; define incorrect customer invoice rate and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from SaaS CTO / VP Product Engineering.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including run golden documents and exceptions against the system of record.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
